name: Asukaze Rin
source:
"Um... What is it? If you have business with me, please make it short."

Head secretary to the CEO of Enigma Games. Because the CEO is prone to keeping out of the public eye, Rin relays information from him to the Enigma team. She has a youthful appearance but is older than she looks, preferring to let her actions do the talking. Whenever [url=/c84005]Arata[/url] has trouble, she often serves as a guide to illuminate the path ahead of him.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
